bullets.text: Minister Dr. R. Kumar inspected the rainwater removal operations in Velachery following heavy flooding.
Rotary International District 3233 honoured 113 teachers at Guru Nanak College in Velachery.
Velachery AGS Colony is under knee-deep water, with residents demanding a permanent flood mitigation plan.
A private ambulance overturned on the Tambaram-Velachery Road due to potholes, injuring a nurse and the driver.
The bodies of two Class 10 students who drowned in Puzhal Lake were recovered after a 17-hour search.
The Greater Corporation of Chennai reported 1,212 rain-related complaints while keeping 220 special camps ready.
The state invited tenders for the comprehensive desilting of the Cooum, Adyar, and Buckingham canals.
Residents near the Puzhuthivakkam MRTS station face detours as one of the station entrances remains closed since March.
Heavy rains flooded residential areas in Ponneri and Minjur, prompting local drainage and relief operations.
Farmers' association members staged a road roko across five locations in Thiruvallur demanding cooperative crop loan waivers.
Motorists faced severe hardships on Poonamallee and Avadi roads due to heavy waterlogging caused by continuous rains.
Vultr and AMD announced a 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai deploying AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs.
MeitY directed Meta to review its recommendation and content ranking algorithms to prevent misleading information.
Google plans a $15 billion AI hub in Visakhapatnam to scale Indian-language tools and AI applications.
Farmers held protests across Thiruvallur district demanding full crop loan waivers from the government.
Reports concerning ED investigations into data center approvals and alleged kickbacks surfaced in political circles.
